review.reason: Australia's Coral Coast page names Coorow Farm's 1.2 km wildflower walk and drive (a board product page too) and stargazing lakes; seasonal wildflowers are the draw. Case for: own section, a named walk at the farm. Case against: a small farming town, a spring-only stop; the farm walk, not the town, is the draw.
review.objection: If kept, the spot may be the Coorow Farm wildflower trail rather than the town.

review.name: Gascoyne Junction
review.reason: Gateway village whose draw is the journey beyond it (Pipiriki benchmark): Australia's Coral Coast's page is mostly about Mount Augustus and the Kennedy Range; in town only a museum collection and a picnic pergola. Case for: own board page, the base for Kennedy Range NP. Case against: its draws are the parks.
review.objection: Also hosts the Gassy Dash (an event, not a reason).

review.name: Quobba
review.reason: Australia's Coral Coast's 'Quobba and Red Bluff' page and Wikivoyage Gascoyne name the Quobba coast (fishing, surfing, snorkelling, Quobba Station stays). Case for: a named remote coast. Case against: it is an area and a station (accommodation), and its specific places, the Quobba Blowholes and Point Quobba lagoon, and Red Bluff, are separate candidates kept here.
review.objection: Risk of a wrapper: keep the blowholes and Red Bluff rather than the area.

considered_not_proposed.name: Ningaloo / Ningaloo Coast (region)
considered_not_proposed.why: A region holding Exmouth, Cape Range NP and Coral Bay would overlap the park destination (every national park is a destination; a region and its sub-area cannot both be). Wikivoyage has no 'Ningaloo' page. Exmouth and Cape Range NP are proposed instead; Coral Bay stands alone.

considered_not_proposed.name: Turquoise Coast
considered_not_proposed.why: No Wikivoyage page and no counted source using it as a destination heading was found (checked the Wikivoyage API); the stretch is split into Nambung NP (with Cervantes) and Jurien Bay, with Green Head, Leeman and Lancelin standalone.

considered_not_proposed.name: Wildflower Country
considered_not_proposed.why: Australia's Coral Coast's seasonal touring brand for inland towns spread over 170 km with no common base; the judge rejected it as a region brand, not a place.

considered_not_proposed.name: Francois Peron National Park
considered_not_proposed.why: Only Skipjack Point is kept inside it: two places, so not a destination; both are Shark Bay spots.

considered_not_proposed.name: Carnarvon
considered_not_proposed.why: Gascoyne hub but only two kept places in reach (the town, the space museum): below the four-spot bar.

considered_not_proposed.name: Coral Bay
considered_not_proposed.why: Two kept places (Coral Bay, Five Fingers Reef): below the bar.

considered_not_proposed.name: Dongara - Port Denison
considered_not_proposed.why: Three kept places: below the bar.

considered_not_proposed.name: Port Gregory / Northampton area
considered_not_proposed.why: Five kept places (Hutt Lagoon, Lynton, Hutt River, Horrocks Beach, Northampton) but no name travellers use for the area as a destination: Wikivoyage files Hutt Lagoon and Hutt River under Kalbarri; 'Chapman Valley' is a shire (rejected). Standalone.

notes: Every pin is provisional unless `pin` is HIGH or MEDIUM: Overpass and Photon were unreachable or rate-limited during this run, so most spots carry coordinates null with `provisional_coordinates` (for span and neighbour reasoning only) and `needs_research` 'coordinates'; Pipeline C must run resolve-pin.py on every spot (route midpoint for walks, OSM natural=beach for beaches, visitor point for parks and islands, place=town for towns). Destination coordinates are all provisional. Hours, cost and ticketUrl are null with needs_research unless a source gave them (Milyering hours/free, Ocean Park hours, Coalseam free, DBCA park pages as ticketUrl for the parks). Spots of the seven proposed destinations carry status 'spot-of-proposed-destination' and go in with their destination. Hutt River Principality is flagged: Wikivoyage says it ended in 2020.
